question: persistent_memory
treatment: Memory starts empty and retains distilled lessons between encounters.
control: The same policy processes the same encounter sequence with memory kept empty.
held_fixed: Local policy and remote specialists; distiller, retrieval and memory-gate design.
sequence_and_separation: 897 encounters from 200 held-out patients; patient visits remain chronological within a randomized sequence. Writeback follows each encounter without recorded answers.
matching_scope: Paired encounter sequence and policy. This isolates the memory condition rather than a revised distiller or training procedure.
outcome_and_cost: Preserve task-native accuracy/privacy measures and specialist-message counts. The case does not establish complete wall-time or monetary matching.
supported_interpretation: Contribution of retained lesson memory under a fixed procedure.
boundary: Retrospective replay with synthetic identifiers; not prospective care or revised-improver evidence.

question: changed_generator_or_recipe
treatment: Full synthesis method with operator and skill updates.
control: Freeze operator updates or freeze skill updates, then train on the same accepted-question target.
held_fixed: Learner-training protocol, accepted target of 10,000 questions and downstream evaluation; acceptance gates remain fixed.
sequence_and_separation: Repair/generate and select training material before learner training; retain separate feedback, selection and external-test roles.
matching_scope: Accepted volume and learner training are matched. Candidate-generation counts differ, so full search-cost matching is not established.
outcome_and_cost: Table 10 reports candidate counts 16,193/36,723/22,398 and native S7 scores 43.22/39.29/40.15 for full/frozen-operator/frozen-skill conditions.
supported_interpretation: The changed synthesis components affect data yield and downstream performance in this bounded comparison.
boundary: A fixed procedure admits generator changes; this does not test a revised improver.

question: changed_generator_or_recipe
treatment: A changed training recipe selects learnable prompts and uses fresh views.
control: Longer training without the selected recipe, under the reported equal-training-compute comparison.
held_fixed: Common reader start, downstream reading protocol and mask-grounded verifier; the designer and acceptance rule stay fixed.
sequence_and_separation: Development data guide revisions; the nominal final test follows frozen choices. Prior use of some nominal test patients is separately disclosed in the source.
matching_scope: The longer-training control addresses training compute. The comparison does not establish equality of all outer-loop search cost.
outcome_and_cost: Retain the source-native lesion recall, false positives and J definitions; report recipe-search and training costs separately.
supported_interpretation: A changed training recipe can affect the trained reader under the stated comparison.
boundary: Retrospective localization with a fixed designer/verifier. Source test-reuse limitations remain visible.

question: revised_improver
treatment: Observed recipe/perception/inference revisions proposed by a fixed designer.
control: The reported recipe and component controls do not compare a revised improvement procedure with its original fixed version.
held_fixed: Designer, attribution, verifier, objective and acceptance rule.
sequence_and_separation: The source evaluates selected revised artifacts. It does not isolate the playbook or a revised procedure through independent subsequent-learning cycles.
matching_scope: No matched changed-improver versus frozen-improver comparison is identified in this case.
outcome_and_cost: No new revised-improver effect or cost value is inferred from the selected-artifact scores.
supported_interpretation: Reported improvements concern revised artifacts under fixed update rules; the later-learning effect of revising those rules is not isolated.
boundary: The reported comparison does not establish whether a revised improver improves subsequent learning.
